stories.s5_udp_hidden_challenge_probe: Agent reuses the durable ProbeManager arm/replay/receipt state machine; single ingress reader owns ACK write; ACK <= request; controller provider dispatches exact single-datagram WAN1/ACK1 over signed v2 transport.

known_limits: Windows and generic read paths use a conservative full-buffer heuristic instead of Linux MSG_TRUNC; a legal 65,507-byte datagram that exactly fills the buffer is dropped on those platforms.
Target-side error isolation is exercised via injected connected-reader failure; no real kernel ICMP quoted-packet correlation is implemented.
Native Windows UDP runtime is not exercised; only a cross-build declares compile evidence. Windows gate returns false.
No real CPE/router or public-WAN vantage; traversal capability remains lab evidence.
P13 wires UDP protocol through the existing P12 direct/manual/gateway composition interfaces; no new traversal adapter and no capability level changes.
A pre-existing timing-sensitive internal/agent receipt test timed out only under full parallel race load and passes in isolation; it is unrelated to UDP changes and was recorded for the reviewers.

delta_reviews.lifecycle_integration: PASS with FIND-1, resolved at close-out

accepted_deviations: Quarantine-state probe drop: while recoveryErr is set, any well-formed WAN1-shaped datagram is consumed without ACK and never forwarded to business, even when it matches no outstanding operation. This is a deliberate fail-closed exception to Story 1 lookalike-fallthrough and is strictly weaker than the TCP ProbeGate, which rejects every inbound connection during the same quarantine state. Ordinary (non-WAN1-shaped) payloads are unaffected. Locked by test TestHandleUDPProbeQuarantineDropsProbeShapedFrames.

review_records.summary: All six Stories implemented with independently reproducible tests; no undeclared edits; frozen artifacts byte-identical; provider-request/v2 flagged as the nearest-to-contract operator-owned revision needing surfacing at integration.

No HIGH or BLOCKING findings. Concurrency, resource accounting (zero after close), anti-amplification, probe full-match auth, provider v2 fail-closed transport, truncation and lifecycle verified clean. LOW/MODERATE notes: replay-capacity overflow/store-failure falls open to business path; replay tombstone lifetime bounded by receipt deadline; non-Linux full-buffer truncation heuristic; per-datagram transient copy not metered.

Frozen WAN1/ACK1/RCT1 bytes and transport-framing semantics unchanged; single ingress reader; strict full-match demux with lookalike fallthrough; transport is Controller-signed in provider-request/v2 canonical; unknown transport and tampering rejected before I/O; exact-source, ACK amplification and truncation correct; netns E2E drives production composition; Windows/native/real-WAN honesty preserved.

Transport-neutral actor reuses Backend hot-update, SideEffectFence rollback, tombstone fences, cleanup retry and shutdown ordering; TCP unchanged; PortRegistry UDP lease preserves overlap/generation/stale-release atomicity; CloseContext joins all workers with zero accounting residue; netns cleanup/signal paths verified; candidate not self-integrated.

review_dispositions: F1 (evidence durability): P13 evidence logs committed as repository blobs following the P10/P12 precedent.
F2 (handoff precision): files_changed split into implementation (18) and metadata (handoff + evidence) lists.

F3 (LOW, test robustness): normal-teardown residue checks report to stderr and only the signal-cleanup test enforces zero residue; the echo-daemon leak grep cannot match an orphaned python3 cmdline. Accepted as test-robustness notes; actual runs leave zero residue.

F4 (LOW, latent): apply hot-update does not guard a same-ID Forward whose protocol changed; the frozen reconcile domain never mutates an existing Forward's protocol. Accepted and noted for a future guard.

F5 (LOW, probe fail-open edge): when replay capacity is full or a store failure occurs, a valid WAN1 is forwarded to the business path rather than dropped/quarantined. No ACK/authenticated material is produced and the probe outcome remains rejected; carries no amplification or oracle exposure.

F6 (informational): the provider request/result JSON schema maps remain unused by the strict decoder (P10 legacy); non-Linux full-buffer truncation heuristic and durable-ACK replay retransmission are accepted design-inherent behavior disclosed in known_limits.
